services.name: Landing Page (Starter)
services.long_description: A single-page marketing site built around one conversion goal — newsletter signup, free trial, or a single product pitch. Includes hero, three feature blocks, social proof, and a call-to-action footer. Mobile-first. Loads under 1 second.

services.name: Landing Page (Premium, A/B tested)
services.short_description: Two-variant landing page with conversion tracking.
services.long_description: Two variants of the landing page. Built-in conversion event logging (no third-party trackers). One round of revisions per variant. Delivered with a one-week post-launch read-out.

services.name: Multi-Page Marketing Site
services.short_description: Home + 4 pages + contact form, fully editable.
services.long_description: Home, About, Services, Case Studies, Contact. CMS-free; content lives in plain markdown so any non-technical operator can edit. One round of copy revisions. Includes favicon + apple-touch icons + sitemap.xml.

services.name: Ecommerce Starter (Square-integrated)
services.short_description: Online store with up to 25 SKUs and Square checkout.
services.long_description: Catalog page, product detail page, cart, Square checkout. Inventory in a simple JSON file (operator-editable). Shipping calculator with 2 tiers. Order confirmation email template. Square gates flipped only after the operator wires real Square credentials in a separate session.

services.name: Brand Identity Kit
services.long_description: Three logo concepts (SVG); chosen logo finalised. Colour palette with hex + RGB + accessibility checks. Typography pair (heading + body). One-page brand guide PDF. All assets delivered as editable SVG and PDF.

services.name: WordPress Build + Operator Handoff
services.short_description: WordPress site you can run yourself.
services.long_description: Custom theme, content migration up to 25 pages, plugin set (SEO + caching + backups), training session for the operator. We do not host — handoff includes deploy notes.

services.name: Ongoing Maintenance (Monthly)
services.long_description: Monthly retainer. Plugin / dependency updates. Uptime monitoring. Up to 2 hours of copy / image edits per month. One emergency response within 24 hours.
